name: Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Stand in front of a bench with one foot planted ahead and the top of your other foot resting on the bench.
Bend your front knee and hip to bring your back knee toward the floor.
Press through your front foot to stand.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Place your front foot far enough forward so your front heel stays planted flat throughout.
Track your front knee in line with your toes and keep your torso tall.
